fieldSets.explanation: Preserves the ingest classification used by processing and evidence read-back.
Raw build controls are retained for expert diagnosis after the recommended automatic build path.

fields.name: trajectoryAutoOpen
fields.explanation: Whether trajectory evidence may open unresolved openings between scanner-visited rooms; administrator-only and off by default.

fields.name: trajectoryClutterDemotion
fields.explanation: Whether walked-floor evidence may demote extracted wall runs standing on ground the scanner was carried over; administrator-only and pass-through by default.
